title: LabOrderStatus
description: The lab or imaging center's answer to a LabOrder (the HL7 v2 ORR^O02 / ACK equivalent, as JSON): it received the order, rejected it, or cancelled it in answer to a `CA`. Sent by the simulated center for the demo, later by the lab vendor's adapter (Q14), to /hooks/lab, whose receiver files it against the order (`received` moves its tracking status to `received`). A second reply with the same `responseId` changes nothing. x-phi marks each field's sensitivity as the API contract does (EXTENSIONS.md).

schemaVersion.description: This shape's version. A change that is not backward-compatible gets a new major version.

correlationId.description: Our order ID (HL7 v2 ORC-2 / OBR-2, placer order number). Every reply echoes it and is filed against it.

responseId.description: The center's ID for this reply (MSH-10), kept on the order's transmission. Never a patient identifier.

status.description: `received` (accepted; HL7 v2 ORC-1 `OK`), `rejected` (it won't perform it; `UA`, with MSA-1 `AE` or `AR`) or `cancelled` (an answer to a `CA`; `CR`).

fillerOrderNumber.description: The center's order number (ORC-3). Required with `received`.

rejection.description: Why it was rejected. Required with `rejected`, absent otherwise.

code.description: HL7 v2 MSA-1: `AE` (application error) or `AR` (application reject).

message.description: The center's reason in words (ERR), shown to the clinician on the order. It may name the test or the patient, so it is clinical data and never logged.

Timestamp.description: An instant, RFC 3339, UTC with Z.

PartnerId.description: An identifier the lab or imaging center assigns. Never a patient identifier.
